answer_summary.first_run_state_machine_exists: PARTIAL — no single unified first-run state machine. Six independent state surfaces compose the first-launch journey: (1) AuthStatus union [unauthenticated|authenticating|authenticated|local|error] owned by main/auth/authService.ts; (2) RuntimeInitState [starting|ready|failed] owned by main/runtimeReadiness.ts; (3) ExperienceProfile.state [pending|completed|skipped] + renderer FirstRunStep [welcome|processing|workspace|discovery|understanding] owned by main/onboarding/experienceProfileService.ts + renderer/firstRun/experienceModel.ts; (4) OnboardingStatus.firstRun boolean + 6 checklist steps owned by main/onboarding/onboardingService.ts; (5) BackendReachability {reachable,checkedAt,lastError} + BackendState [connected|recovering|disconnected] owned by main/runtimeTelemetry.ts; (6) renderer ConnectionState [connecting|online|slow|degraded|offline] owned by renderer/state/ConnectionProvider.tsx (which measures IPC-to-main, NOT the cloud backend). Canonical states NOT_INSTALLED/INSTALLED/DEVICE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED/CONSENT_REQUIRED/POLICY_BOOTSTRAP do not exist as gates.
answer_summary.local_mode_without_backend: YES — MEASURED at unit level (authService.test.ts 19/19 pass; authStateMachine.test.tsx 6/6 pass) and DECLARED at real-Electron level (certification SLICE-17 evidence: local-mode.spec 5/5 PASS on a plain release build, fresh profile, backend down). A fresh install with no stored token never contacts the backend and enters state 'local' with the full shell + LocalModeBanner.
answer_summary.backend_unreachable_ux: Depends on the failure CLASS. Network-level failure (DNS/refused/timeout => BackendError.status 0): fresh install -> local mode (no backend contact at all); returning cloud user -> 5 retries x 1s then local mode, vault kept, auto re-restore on /health recovery edge. HTTP-level failure (any non-2xx, including Cloudflare 52x/530 edge errors): returning cloud user -> treated as GENUINE REJECTION -> vault CLEARED -> state 'unauthenticated' -> escape-less LoginScreen. This second branch is the CURRENT LIVE condition (api.neuropause033.com answers HTTP 530 / Cloudflare error 1033 on /health, /live, /auth/providers — MEASURED 2026-09-12).
answer_summary.health_check: EXISTS — GET {backendUrl}/health, 4000ms abort, throttled to 1 probe/15s, driven by RuntimeSupervisor 20s tick via NeuroCore.snapshot(); early IPC handler answers 'not yet probed' before runtime core; LoginScreen notice polls every 15s and Retry forces a probe. The probe result never gates anything except the auth re-restore edge and UI copy; it does NOT gate readiness.

gate_assessments.reason: First-run journey is fully specified in code and unit/ui-tested (authService 19/19, authStateMachine 6/6 measured here; firstRun.ui/firstRunResume/onboardingConsolidation declared in CI). No unified state machine; NOT_INSTALLED/DEVICE_REGISTRATION/CONSENT/POLICY_BOOTSTRAP gates are absent by design. The real-Electron local-mode e2e is DECLARED green (SLICE-17 evidence) but has no artifact on this checkout and is not in CI. Passable as 'local-first first run' once a human decides that a first run with zero backend/policy contact is the intended launch behaviour.

This mapper did not launch a packaged build. Client-side facts: packaged builds bake https://api.neuropause033.com (measured in local build-info.json and release workflows); first launch mints local-principal.json, experience-profile.json, onboarding.json, vault.bin under userData; no installation-state representation exists in the client. Whether Gatekeeper/unsigned issues block launch belongs to the installation mapper.

Two blocking findings. (1) MEASURED: the baked production backend answers HTTP 530 (Cloudflare tunnel origin down) on /health, /live, /auth/providers — sign-in cannot succeed for any user today. (2) DERIVED from measured: because isNetwork requires BackendError.status===0, a 5xx edge response at launch is classified as a credential rejection: the stored refresh token is destroyed and a returning user is walled on LoginScreen with no 'Keep working locally' escape — exactly the dead end P13C Gate 1 claimed to close, reachable under the current live condition. No test covers the non-network-HTTP-failure branch. Secondary: mid-session refresh on a 5xx logs the user out; a degraded-from-cloud local session is indistinguishable from genuine local-first in the type and the UI.

gaps: authService treats every non-status-0 error as a genuine rejection (authService.ts:266,298-302,422-430); Cloudflare/edge 5xx, 502/503 from a restarting backend, and 429 all destroy the vault. No test exercises this branch.

AuthStatus 'local' carries no 'degradedFromCloud' marker; UI copy 'your data stays on this device' is shown to a user whose vault still holds a cloud session; nothing in the UI says a cloud session exists but could not be restored (log only, authService.ts:291-294).

BackendReachabilityNotice is mounted only on LoginScreen; a local-mode shell never shows backend outage state; ConnectionProvider's 'backend' axis measures IPC-to-main, so the in-shell 'Connected' badge is true even when the cloud is down.

No POLICY_BOOTSTRAP: the desktop never fetches NeuroPause policy/authority state; backend authority enforcement (/pilot) is unreachable from local mode, so local-mode governed actions are authorized entirely on-device.
No CONSENT gate: EULA/privacy 'legal' step is a non-blocking checklist; AI external consent is a first-run choice (fail-closed default) but the first run itself can be skipped.
No DEVICE_REGISTRATION step: device id auto-minted; backend registration only as an org:manage user action.
Playwright e2e (localMode, freshProfileBootstrap) not in CI; no artifacts on this checkout; local-mode GREEN is DECLARED only (SLICE-17 evidence).
verify-e2e-strip.sh (proves the forged-principal seed is absent from release) is not wired into any workflow or release script despite the README instruction.

secureStore.getRefreshToken decrypt failure unlinks vault.bin including provider secrets (secureStore.ts:73-77) — a keychain/signing-identity change on an unsigned build could silently wipe credentials (INFERRED).
RUN-ORDER.md D2 DNS statement (bare droplet IP, grey cloud) is stale relative to live DNS (Cloudflare proxy/tunnel).
Stale-authorization rejection is use-triggered only; an idle 'authenticated' session is never re-validated; renderer ignores accessTokenExpiresAt.

human_decisions_required: Is 'local-first with zero backend/policy contact on first run' the INTENDED public-launch behaviour? In that mode the desktop client is the final authorization authority for everything a local principal can do (RBAC + CST admission resolved on-device), which conflicts with the stated invariant 'client must never be the final authorization authority'.

Is the public backend (api.neuropause033.com, currently HTTP 530 via a Cloudflare tunnel from a development machine) a launch dependency? If yes, launch is blocked until it is reachable from outside; if no, the baked URL and the install guide's 'needs the server' text must change.
Should the transient-vs-rejection rule in authService be widened (machine action 1)? This touches the certified auth path and may require an FG gate ruling.
